gates.why: An incident in Thai or Swahili is as material to a client as one in English.
Incidents the relevance filter drops never reach an analyst.
A model that is worse for any language must not reach production.
Clients are alerted within hours; a backlog during a news spike breaks that promise.
Screening 2.5 million documents a day must stay within the compute and model budget.
A retired model version must never take tagging down or silently change its output.
A new source that the model cannot read must be noticed within days.
